intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} programmes in {{cityA}}. This page compares recorded year tuitions, recent placement rows, and ranks from our table, with official sites opened in {{year}}.
CPJ College vs Shri Ram College of Commerce is not a close ranking fight. SRCC is a public DU college with India Today and Outlook ranks of 1 in 2024.
CPJ is a private college listed at 159 by India Today in 2024 on our records.

sections.heading: CPJ College vs Shri Ram College of Commerce for BCom: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose SRCC if you want a public DU B.Com (Hons) with recorded year tuition of ₹28,843, a 2024 row of ₹9 lakh average and ₹35 lakh highest, and India Today and Outlook ranks of 1 in 2024.

Choose CPJ College only if that private campus is the seat you have, with recorded year tuition of ₹99,800, after you confirm the official notice and treat the 2020 highest of ₹8 lakh as a historical row.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what to watch
paragraphs: For CPJ College we hold year tuition of ₹99,800 for B.Com (Hons). That is a year figure, not a confirmed official three-year total.
For SRCC we hold year tuition of ₹28,843 for B.Com (Hons). Confirm the current college notice, including any society or university charges that sit outside this tuition row.
Check the official pages on cpj.edu.in and srcc.edu before you budget.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: SRCC has a 2024 B.Com (Hons) row of ₹9 lakh average and ₹35 lakh highest, after a 2023 row of ₹9 lakh average and ₹31 lakh highest.
CPJ College has a 2020 B.Com (Hons) row with a highest of ₹8 lakh and no usable average, plus a 2019 row of ₹3 lakh average and ₹4 lakh highest. Ask the campus for a later official report.
These figures are historical records for B.Com (Hons), not a promise for every graduate.

sections.heading: Admission, ranks and eligibility
paragraphs: SRCC is listed with CUET UG. CPJ College has no exam mapped on this page. Follow the official admissions process for each college.
On our records, SRCC has India Today and Outlook ranks of 1 in 2024 and 2023, and a NIRF 2024 rank of 19 recorded against BCom. CPJ College has India Today ranks of 159 in 2024 and 162 in 2023.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both are recorded in Delhi. SRCC is a public college. CPJ College is a private college. The campuses and student communities are not interchangeable.
Visit the campus you would actually join, and read the official prospectus for the exact B.Com (Hons) fee.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick SRCC if a public DU commerce degree, the 2024 placement row and the India Today rank of 1 are the goal, after official fee confirmation.
Pick CPJ College only if that is the seat you have been offered, after you confirm the official ₹99,800-scale year tuition and a later placement note.
The ranking and placement records on this page are not a close match.

faqs.question: What BCom fees are on record for CPJ College and SRCC?
faqs.answer: CPJ College has year tuition of ₹99,800 for B.Com (Hons). SRCC has year tuition of ₹28,843 for B.Com (Hons). These are year figures, not confirmed official three-year totals. Confirm official notices.

faqs.question: How do placements compare?
faqs.answer: SRCC has a 2024 row of ₹9 lakh average and ₹35 lakh highest. CPJ College has a 2020 highest of ₹8 lakh and a 2019 row of ₹3 lakh average and ₹4 lakh highest. Ask CPJ for a later official report.

faqs.question: Which college has the better rank on this page?
faqs.answer: SRCC has India Today and Outlook ranks of 1 in 2024, and a NIRF 2024 rank of 19 recorded against BCom. CPJ College has an India Today rank of 159 in 2024.

faqs.question: How does admission work?
faqs.answer: SRCC is listed with CUET UG. CPJ College has no exam mapped on this page. Follow the official admissions process for each college.

faqs.question: Are both public colleges?
faqs.answer: No. SRCC is recorded as a public college in Delhi. CPJ College is recorded as a private college in Delhi.

faqs.question: Is this a close comparison?
faqs.answer: Not on ranks or on the placement rows we hold. SRCC is a public DU commerce college with much stronger recorded ranks. CPJ College may still be the practical option if that is the seat you have.
